calls.statement:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS gold_member_count
FROM dim_member
WHERE tier = 'Gold' AND is_current = TRUE

SELECT tier, COUNT(*) AS member_count
FROM dim_member
WHERE is_current = TRUE
GROUP BY tier
ORDER BY tier

calls.statement:
SELECT member_id, COUNT(*) AS version_count
FROM dim_member
WHERE is_current = TRUE
GROUP BY member_id
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
LIMIT 10

SELECT MIN(valid_to) AS earliest_valid_to, MAX(valid_to) AS latest_valid_to
FROM dim_member
WHERE is_current = TRUE

SELECT MAX(valid_from) AS latest_update
FROM dim_member
WHERE is_current = TRUE

SELECT COUNT(*) AS gold_count, COUNT(DISTINCT member_id) AS distinct_gold_members
FROM dim_member
WHERE tier = 'Gold' AND is_current = TRUE
